hypothesis: Premature unmounting on DOMContentLoaded creates a race condition where unhydrated SSR DOM is exposed before React splash animation mounts, and lacks check for session storage or standalone mode.
Client component returns null on initial SSR/hydration render because isStandalone defaults to false, exposing underlying UI elements and creating hydration flicker.
AppShellSkeleton uses fixed light theme stone-50 colors without standalone display mode media query defense, leaking bright skeleton during pre-hydration.
Mismatch between viewport themeColor (#fafaf9), appleWebApp statusBarStyle (default), and splash animation dark theme (#162832) causes WebKit cold start status bar flash.
